messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — planning rollout for client-side feature flags for the new regional fallback policy. Concern: flag cache staleness could cause clients in a region to keep hitting downgraded model variants after server-side rollback.
Samir K: +1. What's our flag update path? polling vs push?
Maya R: Right now SDK uses polling with local TTL + exponential backoff. Default TTL is 5m. Thinking we need faster invalidation for critical rollout flags.
Drew L: 5m seems long for rollback-sensitive flags. Can we add a short-circuit fetch when global kill-switch flips?
Priya S: We have a global kill key in control plane. ops-bot can emit a broadcast event, but not all clients subscribe. Mobile clients particularly stick to TTL.
Samir K: For staged rollout we do: 1) server-side routing to model v2 for 10% in region, 2) feature flag on client to enable UI tweaks. If rollback, need <30s propagation.
Maya R: Proposal: introduce two flag classes — "soft" (TTL 5m) and "hard" (TTL 15s + push). Only use "hard" for model-switch kill-switch and immediate fallbacks. Documented in SDK.
Drew L: How about network churn? For mobile offline clients, hard TTL still won't help. We should include behavior: if client offline after receiving flag, on reconnect always revalidate immediately.
Priya S: Agree. Also suggest server-side short-lived session affinity so clients that haven't refreshed don't keep pinned to old variant. That buys time.
Samir K: Telemetry needs to track: flag_version, last_refresh_ts, decision_source (server/poll/push). Add metrics: flag_refresh_lag_p95 by platform.
Maya R: Telemetry + rollout gating: block >1% p50 refresh_lag > 30s in a region before increasing traffic slice. Add canary stage that monitors refresh_lag and error rate.
Drew L: Can we add a fallback TTL override API? ops-bot trigger: 
```json
{ "flag": "region_model_v2", "override_ttl_sec": 10 }
```
ops-bot: noted — we can add a one-off override endpoint (authenticated). Will post audit log when used.
Priya S: Rollout stages draft: STAGE 0: Shadow sampling (no client flag flip). STAGE 1: 1% server-side routing + client soft flag (observe). STAGE 2: 5% server-side + set hard flag for selected cohorts. STAGE 3: regional ramp if telemetry green.
Samir K: Launch criteria: p99 latency delta < 10% and error-rate delta < 0.1% for 24h in canary region; flag_refresh_p95 < 20s.
Maya R: Rollback ladder: immediate global kill-switch via ops-bot -> hard flag push -> server fallback routing -> disable model v2 traffic. Each step should be idempotent.
Drew L: Add a safety: if a client sees inconsistent decision_source for same session (server vs local) more than twice, log event and force re-eval. Low-volume but good to detect SDK bugs.
Priya S: Customer ask: enterprise customers with on-prem Private want control over TTL defaults. We should expose config and doc the tradeoffs.
Samir K: Can we add a test harness (local) to simulate stale flags? devex could provide a small tool to flip flag and delay refresh to validate client behavior.
Maya R: Action items: Samir - draft SDK flag classes + API for override (ETA 2 days). Drew - session affinity design + detection (ETA 4 days). Priya - update rollout playbook with telemetry gates and enterprise config notes (ETA 3 days). ops-bot - stub endpoint for override + audit logging.
ops-bot: acknowledged. I'll create a runbook snippet and post a follow-up when endpoint exists. :white_check_mark:
Maya R: Thanks. We'll reconvene after PRs land and draft a short canary checklist for launch readiness. :eyes:
